calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ids, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) web_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist_sl
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4

calls.statement:
SELECT r.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.refund_net) refund, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT reason_code, count(*) n, sum(quantity_returned) units, sum(refund_net) refund, min(refund_net/NULLIF(quantity_returned,0)) mn_unit, max(refund_net/NULLIF(quantity_returned,0)) mx_unit
FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory<>'Garden Furniture' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) asw_not_gf,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_rows
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p0 ON p0.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.sku=p0.sku AND p.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND p.category='Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
